description_en: Modifies the deployment mode of an instance
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb modify-db-instance-deployment-mode --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --deploy-mode multiple --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBInstanceDeploymentMode

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a region
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The deployment mode. Valid values:
multiple: multi-zone deployment.
single: single-zone deployment
parameters.help_zh:
部署模式。取值说明：
multiple：多可用区部署。
single：单可用区部署
parameters.name: deploy_mode

parameters.help_en:
The secondary zone ID.


This parameter is required only for multi-zone deployment.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html operation to query available zone IDs.
The secondary zone ID must be different from the primary zone ID
parameters.help_zh:
备可用区ID。


仅多可用区部署时需传入该参数。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html接口查看可用的可用区ID。
备可用区ID必须与主可用区ID不一致
parameters.name: standby_zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The vSwitch ID in the secondary zone.


This parameter is required only for multi-zone deployment.
The zone of the vSwitch specified by this parameter must be the same as the zone specified by StandbyZoneId
parameters.help_zh:
备可用区VSwitch ID。


仅多可用区部署时需传入该参数。
备可用区VSwitch ID所在可用区必须与StandbyZoneId保持一致
parameters.name: standby_vswitch_id
